baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative يَسَّرْنَا is purposively joined to لِلذِّكْرِ, and ذ ك ر returns in مُّدَّكِرٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Divine facilitation readies recited Quran as an external reminder that can become internal recollection; the closing question leaves actual uptake to a remembering agent.

activation_trace.role: Ease and readiness after difficulty supply the enabling action.
Reading and recitation supply the transmissible form being enabled.
Recovery after forgetting supplies the inward result and the agentive response.
A reminder that restores presence makes the Quran the means of recall.

changed_reading.after: The Quran has been made ready as recitation and reminder so that a hearer can recover and actively retain what forgetfulness loses.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قُرْءَانَ activates gathering as well as recitation, while the doubled ذ ك ر construction links the gathered object to retrieval and utterance.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Quran is a gathered body whose collected form routes dispersed material into recollection and speech; facilitation concerns the retrievability and articulability of the gathered whole.

activation_trace.role: Gathering parts into a whole supplies the Quran's collected form.
Light, compliant movement supplies tractability from collection to uptake.
Recollection gathers absent material back into present awareness.
Mention on the tongue gives retrieved material an outward path.

changed_reading.after: A gathered discourse has been made tractable to retrieve, recollect, and voice.

context_deltas.mechanism: Temporal nearness, recurrence or passage, and eventual settlement activate the Quran branch of a time that comes or is delayed: facilitation becomes timely re-presentation that repeatedly opens a chance to remember before matters settle.

activation_trace.role: A time that comes or is delayed makes Quranic availability temporally charged.
Recall after absence supplies the repeated reopening of awareness.
A time drawing near supplies the narrowing interval for response.
Temporal occurrence and recurrence supply a cycling rather than one-time encounter.
Fixity and settlement supply the endpoint against which renewed chances matter.

structural_cues: 54:1 announces nearness, 54:2 calls the sign مُّسْتَمِرٌّ, and 54:3 says every matter is مُّسْتَقِرٌّ before the focus refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nearness, recurrence, settlement, and a Q-R-ء timing branch; I infer a cycle of timely re-presentation, while the live alternative takes مُّسْتَمِرٌّ only as continuity and leaves facilitation non-temporal.

changed_reading.before: The Quran possesses a static property of ease.
changed_reading.after: The Quran is repeatedly made available at consequential moments, reopening recollection before the approaching sequence settles.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible signs, reached wisdom, and available warning coexist with deliberate turning away and failure to avail. Facilitation therefore removes barriers to encounter and recollection without mechanically producing assent.

activation_trace.role: Readiness after difficulty supplies genuine accessibility without specifying the response.
The reminder supplies an available prompt whose activation remains personal.
Actual seeing supplies achieved perceptual access.
Turning one's side away supplies the contrary volitional response.
Arrival at the goal supplies successful delivery of wisdom.
Failure of sufficiency marks the gap between delivered warning and changed conduct.

structural_cues: 54:2 coordinates seeing a sign with turning away; 54:4-5 say reports arrived with deterrence and wisdom reached its mark, yet warnings did not avail.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successful perception and arrival alongside refusal and non-availing warning; I infer that facilitation enables but does not coerce uptake, while a live alternative confines the earlier failure to those warnings rather than the Quran.

changed_reading.before: If the Quran is easy, reception should follow.
changed_reading.after: Ease makes encounter and recollection possible but does not override a hearer's capacity to turn away; فَهَلْ is a real uptake test.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated summons leads toward a strange, hard event. The direct Y-S-R/A-S-R contrast scopes ease to the Quran-for-remembrance rather than promising an easy event or an easy world.

activation_trace.role: Ease opposed to hardship supplies the marked local contrast.
Recitation identifies the specific object whose approach is eased.
Calling by speech supplies an imperative movement toward encounter.
A difficult, strange thing supplies the summons' alarming object.
The repeated caller turns the earlier summons into an enacted response.
Explicit difficulty and severity delimit what the later ease does and does not cover.

structural_cues: 54:6 introduces the caller and a strange thing; 54:7-8 enact compelled emergence and haste, ending with هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a hard summoned event and the focus supplies an eased Quran; I infer that the contrast localizes mercy in access to warning, while the live alternative treats Y-S-R and A-S-R as adjacent but functionally unrelated.

changed_reading.before: Facilitation suggests a generally softened experience.
changed_reading.after: The Quran is the eased route to remembrance precisely within a sequence whose event remains strange and hard.

context_deltas.mechanism: Opening, converging flows, measured coordination, and a vessel of fastened planks activate Quran-as-gathering and facilitation-as-tractable motion. The gathered discourse becomes an assembled carrier that keeps remembrance moving through overwhelming material.

activation_trace.role: Gathering parts supplies the focus-side analogue for assembly.
Light, compliant movement supplies the carrier's tractability.
A reminder that restores presence names what the carrier preserves in motion.
Opening a closure supplies release into the narrative flow.
Two opposed things arriving together supplies convergence into one mechanism.
Deliberate measured ordering supplies coordination rather than accidental collision.
A broad board used for writing or building joins textual surface to vessel construction.
Fasteners that bind planks supply cohesion among gathered parts.
Running and flowing supply successful passage by the assembled carrier.

structural_cues: 54:11-12 move from opened upper gates and burst lower springs to meeting waters under measure; 54:13-14 then move to fastened planks that run under care.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the physical vessel sequence and a board branch spanning writing and building; I map vessel assembly to corpus assembly and its motion to transmissibility, while the live alternative limits the vessel solely to preservation of Noah's sign.

changed_reading.before: The Quran is an easy text presented after the flood account.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its gathered and tractable form acts like an assembled carrier that transports remembrance through otherwise overwhelming material.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact closing question first follows an intentionally left sign and then follows the facilitated Quran. Repetition maps preservation into recitable retrieval: the Quran carries the memorial force of the surviving sign into renewed present uptake.

activation_trace.role: Repeatable recitation supplies the present medium of retrieval.
A reminder restoring presence supplies continuity between trace and hearer.
Leaving a surviving effect supplies durable historical residue.
A manifest sign gives the residue an addressable memorial function.
The same reminder branch at the earlier refrain links preserved sign to renewed recollection.

structural_cues: 54:15 and 54:17 share فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ, with the punishment-and-warning question of 54:16 between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a preserved trace, a sign, an exact refrain, and then facilitated Quran; I infer that recitation mediates retrieval of the prior event, while the live alternative treats the repeated question as exhortation without a carrier relation.

changed_reading.after: The Quran is a repeatable medium that carries an intentionally preserved sign into present recollection, and the repeated question asks who will reactivate it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates Y-S-R's lots-and-division image and the moon's half-image rather than the ordinary ease branch. It remains anchored in يَسَّرْنَا and قُرْءَانَ and gains a context trigger from ٱنشَقَّ, but downstream prose must label it a part-whole analogy, not a lexical gloss or a claim that this ayah specifies formal textual divisions.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَسَّرْنَا can carry an apportioning image while قُرْءَانَ carries gathering, creating a live tension between distributed parts and collected whole.

activation_trace.role: Division into allotted shares supplies an unusual mechanism for manageable uptake.
Gathering into a whole supplies the counter-pole that keeps partition from becoming dispersal.
A half or counterpart split from a whole activates the part-whole operation.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, facilitation may include making a gathered whole available in apportioned, manageable units without losing its collected identity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps eschatological emergence onto cognition. It remains valid as an analogy anchored in ذ ك ر's restoration after forgetting and supported by contextual emergence and revivification branches, but downstream prose must not equate remembering lexically with bodily resurrection.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled ذ ك ر construction presents remembering as bringing absent content back into active presence.

activation_trace.role: Restoring what forgetting removed supplies cognitive return to presence.
The reminder supplies the instrument that initiates reactivation.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the spatial image for retrieval.
Reviving the dead supplies the strong context analogue for restored presence.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, Quranic reminding reactivates what had fallen absent, a cognitive re-emergence that anticipates the context's bodily emergence.

strongest_changes: Ease became prepared access without compelled assent.
The 54:15/54:17 refrain made the Quran a repeatable carrier of a preserved sign.
The hard-day contrast sharply localized ease in access to remembrance rather than in the warned event.
summary.what_was_special: The trace held together lexical ease, gathering, recitation, and recall with context mechanisms of refusal, hardness, temporal reopening, material assembly, and preserved-sign retrieval without collapsing them into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The Q-R-ء timing branch may be too form-distant to support recurrent availability beyond an exploratory status.
The vessel analogy may belong only as a contained preservation model rather than as a general account of Quranic form.
The apportionment outlier should not be promoted without independent evidence for a part-whole reading.
